Same offer, from his chair. If you stayed quiet, talking got him zero instead of one. If you talked, three instead of five. Either way, talking cut his prison years.
And for me?

Same for you. Whatever Ravi did, talking cut your years. One year each was on the table. Neither of you could reach it alone.
Prisoner’s dilemma

Each person’s better move, with the other’s move held fixed, leaves both worse off when both choose it. Here: three years each, instead of one.

Is it always like this?

02 / TOMORROW EXISTS
A different life.
Meera
Different life. You run a café. Meera runs the one next door. For ten days, you both set today’s price each morning. You’ll see her again—until the ten days end.
Open the café.
